summary.text: Adrian Fontes is the incumbent Democratic Secretary of State, a Marine Corps veteran, former prosecutor and former Maricopa County Recorder, elected in 2022. His campaign focuses on protecting early voting and vote-by-mail, voter privacy and election funding.

paragraphs.text: Fontes was born in Nogales, Arizona, and lives in Phoenix.
He served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1992 to 1996, then earned a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University in 1998 and a law degree from the University of Denver in 2000.

As an attorney he worked as a prosecutor in the Denver district attorney's office and the Maricopa County Attorney's office, and he led the International Prosecution Unit at the Arizona Attorney General's Office.
He was Maricopa County Recorder before being elected Secretary of State in 2022, and he has held the office since January 2, 2023.
